header.title: The Visual Language of Atelier Verdant

body_sections.heading: Opening
body_sections.prose:
Atelier Verdant reads as a workshop that lets you in for a quiet hour. The visual register sits between editorial gravity and material plainness. There is no glow, no gradient, no upward inflection.

The commitment is to evidence of the maker. Every surface should carry a trace — the weave of the cloth, the file mark on the brass, the hand of the typesetter. The system rewards looking close.

body_sections.heading: The color system
body_sections.prose:
The palette runs ink to cream to brass to soft rust. Color appears in proportion, not saturation. Two darks anchor every layout, a cream ground breathes, a gold accent dignifies one moment per composition.

The brand will not chase the season. The same four hex values carry the whole year, recombined rather than refreshed.

body_sections.heading: The typography
body_sections.prose:
Display sits in editorial gravity: a serif with weight in the body of the letter, not in the terminals. Body type stays out of its own way — a clean grotesque that holds long reading without fatigue.

The pairing speaks in a voice that does not perform reassurance. Captions live in monospace because the workshop labels its own work.

body_sections.heading: What this brand is not
body_sections.prose:
Not glossy. Not gradient. Not warm-LED. Not animated transitions for their own sake. Not the visual idiom of fast fashion or commodity housewares.

The brand refuses the corporate sans-and-photography idiom that surrounds the category. If a touchpoint borrows the lighting of a hotel lobby or the cadence of a tech keynote, it is not this brand. It is a draft for a different one.

body_sections.heading: Decisions ahead
body_sections.prose:
Decide the studio's daylight palette under cloud cover so every shoot can match it.

Decide how the gold accent is rationed. Used freely it becomes the primary; used once per composition it stays a signal.

Decide the relationship to imagery. The workshop owns its own photography or it borrows none. Stock photography is not on the table.

swatches.label: Primary
swatches.rationale: Ink anchors every layout. The deepest reading on the page.

swatches.label: Secondary
swatches.rationale: Worn rust that carries the material plainness of the workshop.

swatches.label: Accent
swatches.rationale: Gold lifts a single moment per composition. Used once, never twice.

swatches.label: Neutral
swatches.rationale: Cream ground that lets the system breathe and keeps the contrast honest.

display.rationale: Editorial seriousness without academic stiffness; weight in the body of the letter.

body.rationale: Neutral grotesque that holds long reading without competing with the display register.
